'''Kendl Johnson''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a supporting pentagonist in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. She is the daughter of [[Beverly Johnson]] and the only sister of deuteragonist [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]], protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] and deceased brother [[Brian Johnson]] and the fiancée of tritagonist [[Cesar Vialpando|Cesar "Ces" Vialpando]]. She is voiced by [[Yolanda Whittaker|Yolanda "Yo-Yo" Whittaker]].

==Character history==
===Life in Los Santos===
Kendl was born to mother [[Beverly Johnson]] and an unnamed father in the [[Johnson House]] on [[Grove Street]] in [[Ganton]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. She was raised by her mother, and possibly her father, alongside Carl, Sweet and Brian, sometimes telling Beverly of Carl and Brian's misbehavior. Sometime in 1987, tragedy struck the Johnson family as Brian passed away and, feeling guilty after being present at his death, Carl moved to [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], dropping all contact with his family back in Los Santos. Kendl and Sweet, the [[Gang Leaders|leader]] of the [[Grove Street Families]], began to grow further apart, which is later compounded when Kendl begins dating Mexican-American [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] gang leader [[Cesar Vialpando]].

She continued dating Cesar into [[1992]], although her happiness once again is setback with [[The Introduction|Beverly's death]] at the hands of three [[Ballas]] gangsters, who had been attempting to assassinate Sweet. Kendl, outside the house, ran towards the front door but was held back by Sweet, who had witnessed Beverly's death having been inside the house. She attends the [[Sweet & Kendl|funeral]] along with Sweet and his childhood friend [[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]]. The three are [[Big Smoke (mission)|later joined]] by another childhood friend [[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]] and Carl, returning for his mother's funeral. She is initially glad to see Carl but quickly leaves to return to Cesar, arguing with Sweet yet again.

Carl later walks into an argument between the two, again regarding Cesar, with Kendl criticizing Sweet's lifestyle and racist attitude, while Sweet claims that Kendl looks like a prostitute. Kendl storms out of his [[Sweet's House|house]] and goes to [[Unity Station]] to meet Cesar. Sweet tells Carl to follow her, so he can see what his problem is with Cesar. Carl follows, obtaining a low rider, and [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|winning a low-rider challenge]], which impresses Cesar. The two, with help from Kendl, agree to be 'cool, for now'. The two meet, again with Kendl, on their way to an illegal low-rider street race, which Carl eventually [[High Stakes, Low Rider|wins]].

===Life in exile===
Kendl continues to live with Cesar until [[The Green Sabre|the arrest of both her brothers]], which also results in Smoke and Ryder, who have actually betrayed the duo out of a secretive alliance with the Ballas and corrupt C.R.A.S.H. officers [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski|Edward "Eddie" Pulaski]] under pressure, assuming leadership roles in the Grove Street Families and instead crippling them, forcefully allying them with the [[C.R.A.S.H.]], [[Ballas]], [[Los Santos Vagos]] and the [[Russian Mafia]]. The new alliance takes control of the Grove Street Families and Varrios Los Aztecas territories, forcing Kendl and Cesar to flee to [[Angel Pine]] in [[Whetstone]], where they [[King in Exile|briefly meet Carl]]. There she helps convince Cesar not to return to Los Santos, saying she is aware of the enemy's strong foothold, and reveals her suspicions about Smoke to Carl, asking how he as a gangster could afford a [[Big Smoke's House|new house]].

Carl later [[Mobile Phone|phones]] Cesar to tell him to bring Kendl to [[San Fierro]], where he was about to set up after [[Farewell, My Love...|winning]] the deeds to a [[Doherty Garage|garage]]. The garage, run down and out of business, is viewed by Carl as a disaster but by Kendl [[Wear Flowers In Your Hair|as an opportunity to build a business up from scratch]]. Carl, with help from aging hippie [[The Truth]], returns with two new mechanics, [[Dwaine|Dwayne]] and [[Jethro]], along with an electronics expert [[Zero]], and Kendl begins to run the business for her brother. During this time she complains to Carl and Cesar that workers on a building site next to the garage had been harassing her, leading to [[Deconstruction|Carl killing the workers and locking the foreman into a portable toilet, which was pushed into a hole and covered with concrete in revenge]].

Kendl is later shown to complain about the laziness of Carl, Cesar, Dwayne and Jethro, saying that this was to be their opportunity but realises that the four were awaiting news from [[Zero]] on how they were to [[Zeroing In|steal]] a [[Uranus]] for [[Wang Cars|a newly acquired showroom down the street]]. At some point [[Saint Mark's Bistro|not seen during the game's storyline]], she meets up with [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]], the blind leader of the Chinese-American [[San Fierro Triads]], joining him at [[The Four Dragons Casino]] to judge auditions, along with Carl, for the casino's entertainment. During a brief break through the auditions, she also meets rehabilitated rapper [[Madd Dogg]], who had been [[Madd Dogg (mission)|saved]] by Carl and who wanted help in [[A Home in the Hills|reclaiming]] his [[Madd Dogg's Mansion|mansion]] from [[Big Poppa]], a [[Los Santos Vagos]] drug dealer. Kendl later phones Carl to say that she and Cesar would be going to San Fierro to finish off business with the garage.

[[File:EndoftheLine-GTASA5.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Kendl, [[Carl Johnson|Carl]], [[Sweet]] and [[Cesar Vialpando]] witnessing [[Frank Tenpenny|Frank Tenpenny's]] final moments, during [[End of the Line]].]]
===Return to Los Santos===
Kendl and Cesar [[Riot (GTA SA)|later]] visit Madd Dogg's mansion, which was successfully taken back, and sit with the recently [[Home Coming|paroled]] Sweet, [[The Gurning Chimps]] lead singer [[Maccer]] and The Truth as the news covers Tenpenny's arrest and trial. The group watches in horror as Tenpenny is found not guilty and riots ensue around the poorer neighborhoods of the city. Cesar, around this time, also asks Carl if Sweet would be okay about him proposing marriage to Kendl, although this question remains unanswered.

Kendl and Cesar, while Carl and Sweet were [[End of the Line|killing Smoke and Tenpenny and destroying]] Smoke's [[Big Smoke's Crack Palace|drug manufacturing plant]], go to the Johnson House. After Tenpenny crashes his [[Fire Truck|firetruck]] off a bridge and into Grove Street, she and Cesar go to witness his final moments along with Carl, Sweet and The Truth, who had been chasing him. She and Cesar stay at the Johnson house and meets with Maccer, record producer [[Kent Paul]], Madd Dogg and disbarred former lawyer [[Ken Rosenberg|Ken "Rosie" Rosenberg]], suggesting that to celebrate they should go 'roll some dice with Woozie'.

==Personality==
Kendl is depicted as intelligent, and pragmatic, suggesting that she could be successful within the bounds of law, as her determination to turn Carl's [[Doherty Garage|garage]] from a run down building into a thriving business.She also possesses  entrepreneurial talents, strong willpower, creativity, and a sense of leadership. She has little tolerance for whining or complaining, which causes Carl and others to regard her as a bit bossy.

==Trivia==
*Kendl only appears in cutscenes and not in actual missions, as does Tenpenny, despite accompanying Cesar in the mission [[High Stakes, Low Rider]]. During the mission she is replaced by a street pedestrian. She, [[Burning Desire|much like Tenpenny]], only calls Carl once as CJ, during [[King in Exile|their brief meeting in the trailer in Angel Pine]].
